## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you would like to see added.

## Problem or Use Case
What problem does this feature solve? How does it improve threat hunting, DFIR, or security auditing workflows?

## Proposed Solution / Design
Describe the desired implementation, CLI flags, output changes, or programmatic API behavior.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Safety & Invariant Compliance
- [ ] Confirmed that this feature preserves **zero external runtime dependencies** (Python standard library only).
- [ ] Confirmed that this feature respects PersistHunt's **strict read-only auditing guarantee**.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or references here.
